callStatus.description: `status` on a call row: normalizeCallStatus's canonical set, the voice agent's "abandoned" (answered, then the caller never spoke) and "unknown" (no status stored). A value outside this list is a raw provider status and the portal shows it as sent.

callDirection.description: `direction` on a call or message row, as stored (Call.direction, Message.direction).

callType.description: `type` on a call row (calls, overview) and `direction` on a timeline call event: the direction, with an unanswered inbound call read as "missed".

sentiment.description: `sentiment` on a call row, written by the voice agent's post-call analysis. The portal labels "negative" as friction.

disposition.description: `disposition` on a call row, written by the voice agent's post-call analysis. The portal shows the value itself (hyphens as spaces, capitalized); it has no label for any of them.

transferStatus.description: `transferStatus` on a call row: the real outcome of a hand-off to a person. `completed` appears only in the recorded contract fixtures; the server never writes it and the portal shows no badge for it.

transferReason.description: `transferReason` on a call row whose transfer failed. A missing or unrecognised bucket reads as `fallback`, which is also what the portal shows for `room_not_found` and `provider_unsupported`, the two it has no label for. `caller_requested_human` appears only in the recorded contract fixtures, on a transfer that did not fail, where the portal shows no reason.

funnelStage.description: `funnelData[].name` in GET /api/district/analytics: an English display name that is a key.

analyticsSentiment.description: `sentimentDistribution[].name` in GET /api/district/analytics: an English display name that is a key.

memberRole.description: `role` on a workspace member (GET /api/district/workspace/members, the workspace list).

region.description: A workspace's data region. `en`/`fr` are the short names (chips, sentences); the long names add the datacenter. An unrecognised id is shown upper-cased, never as a default region.

deskTicketSource.description: `source` on a Desk ticket. The portal labels a ticket opened from a call; a manual ticket carries no source label.

knowledgeDocumentStatus.description: `documents[].status` in GET /api/district/workspace/knowledge. The portal reads `processing` as indexing; an unrecognised value is shown as sent, and an empty one as `fallback`.

workflowRunStatus.description: `status` on a workflow run and `latestRun.status` on a workflow (GET /api/district/workflows, /workflows/runs). An unrecognised value is shown as sent.

workflowAction.description: `actionResults[].type` on a workflow run, and `actions[].type` on a workflow.

workflowActionOutcome.description: `actionResults[].outcome` on a workflow run. The portal shows the value itself (only its colour depends on it); it has no label for any of them.

workflowActionReason.description: The code that opens `actionResults[].reason` on a workflow run: the reason is an English sentence `<code>: <detail>` (the detail can name a number, a tag or a status). The portal shows the whole sentence as sent and labels none of them; an app shows the code's entry, never the detail.

numberCapability.description: `numbers[].capabilities[]` in GET /api/district/workspace/provider/numbers. The portal shows the value itself; it has no label for any of them.

numberProvider.description: `numbers[].provider` in GET /api/district/workspace/provider/numbers, and `provider` in the number search response. `unknown` is a managed number whose carrier is not recorded.

messageDeliveryStatus.description: `status` on a message (timeline `events[].status`, inbox `lastMessage.status`): the delivery receipt states, plus `received` on an inbound message. The portal labels them on email rows (`queued` reads as sent) and shows `failed` as the word itself in both languages; "Email received" is email-only, so `received` has no label here.

researchStatus.description: `dgiStatus` on a contact (GET /api/district/contacts, /contacts/get): the lead research job.

contactResearchKey.description: The keys of `intelligence` on a contact (the lead research blob). The labels are the contact drawer's section headings for them.

values.fr: Amorces de conversation pour la direction

lineType.description: `phoneIntel.lineType` and `intelligence.callerIntel.lineType` on a contact: the carrier lookup's line type, normalised into Twilio's words. Any other value is shown as sent. The labels are the portal's words for the same line types in its forwarding guide.

billingSubscriptionStatus.description: `subscriptions[].status` in GET /api/billing: the Stripe statuses the route lists. The portal shows "Cancels soon" for any of them with `cancelAtPeriodEnd`, which is not a status.

billingInvoiceStatus.description: `invoices[].status` in GET /api/billing: Stripe's invoice status, passed through. The portal shows the value itself; it has no label for any of them.

numberStatus.description: `numbers[].status` in GET /api/district/workspace/provider/numbers: a managed number's `PhoneNumberIndex.status` (missing reads as `active`; `released` rows are left out of the list), and for a number on the workspace's own carrier account the carrier's word (`active` from Twilio and Sinch; Telnyx's own status passed through, so another value can arrive). `pending_verification` is a toll-free number under carrier review (POST /api/district/workspace/tfv); `suspended` is set by staff. The portal shows the value itself and has no label for any of them; an empty one shows as `fallback`.

a2pCampaignType.description: `campaignType` in the POST /api/district/workspace/a2p body: the A2P 10DLC use case a registration is filed under. A request value; the route files any other value as Twilio's MIXED.

a2pRegistrationStatus.description: `status` in the POST /api/district/workspace/a2p answer: Twilio's campaign status, passed through (`IN_PROGRESS` when Twilio sends none). Twilio's SDK types it as a string and names these three as examples, so another value can arrive and is shown as sent. The portal has no label for any of them.

tollFreeVerificationStatus.description: `status` in the POST /api/district/workspace/tfv answer: Twilio's toll-free verification status, passed through. The portal has no label for any of them.

sipTrunkStatus.description: `trunks[].status` in GET /api/district/workspace/sip and `trunk.status` in its POST: the trunk's billing row status. A trunk's row is written `active` and nothing changes it; the portal badges every listed trunk with this label.

schedulingWebhookDeliveryStatus.description: `items[].status` in the scheduling admin op `webhooks.deliveries`: what the scheduler's worker stores (internal/worker/worker.go in the district-scheduler fork: `pending`, then `success` or `failed`). `failed` has no single label: the portal shows "No answer" without a `response_status` and "Rejected with {code}" with one (schedulingI18n.ts developer).

schedulingHostRole.description: `role` on an event type's host in the scheduling admin ops `eventTypes.hosts*`.

schedulingQuestionType.description: `type` on a booking question in the scheduling admin ops `eventTypes.questions.*`.
